title: Filesystem
description: A filesystem entry as reported by file tools: metadata for a path, with content only for readable text files.

path.description: Absolute path, or workspace-relative when the tool was invoked with a root.

mode.description: POSIX permission bits as an octal string, e.g. 0644.

executable.description: True when the file has the executable bit.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the file contents, used for change detection.

content.description: File contents; omitted for directories and binary files.

ignored.description: True when matched by gitignore rules.
